pages.text: The finale’s FTB victory rewards are Tears for Fears, also called Ranker’s Sword, and four Potions of Radiation. Follow the victory and final sword tasks in the questbook. Radiation is harmful; handle those bottles accordingly.

Your Inferno victory marks the combat finale. The Unfinished Promise continues alongside that journey: helping the twelve NPCs and completing your personal awakening are separate milestones. Chapter 22 explains the awakening requirements and its experimental availability in this development build.
Thank you for playing. Keep building, help your teammates reach their own milestones, and share useful issue reports when something needs attention.
